name: claude-min-plugin
description: Coding guidelines that reduce common LLM mistakes, plus a commit workflow with AI-attribution trailers and a worktree merge helper

reply_zh_hant.title: Reply in Traditional Chinese
reply_zh_hant.description: Claude replies in Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant). Code, commands, identifiers, and commit messages stay in their original language.

commit_gate.title: Confirm before git commit
commit_gate.description: Ask for explicit confirmation before any git commit runs, so commits are never created without you seeing them first.
